class BadInput:
    text: str

def sum_parsed(xs: list[str]) -> int fail BadInput:
    """Parse every string as an int and return the sum; fail with BadInput carrying the first string that is not an integer."""
    ex sum_parsed(["1", "2", "3"]) == Ok(6)
    ex sum_parsed([]) == Ok(0)
    ex sum_parsed(["1", "x", "y"]) == Err(BadInput(text="x"))
    total = 0
    for s in xs:
        total += s.parse_int() else fail BadInput(s.copy())
    return total
